scope: Local-only audit of four interrupted published-regime checkpoints; no training, upload, cloud execution, or external storage.

design_amendment.provenance: The initial implementation incorrectly indexed fresh tasks from each finite training-library prefix. Its outputs are retained only as an explicitly labeled in-library control and are not used for unseen-task competence, coverage, or morphology claims.
design_amendment.correction: The corrected audit draws one shared fresh task bank directly from independent Gaussian vectors w~N(0,I8), with no library indexing, and reuses the identical x/tasks/noisy labels for every checkpoint and observed-label prefix.

fresh_prompt_design.task_sampling: independent fresh continuous Gaussian task vectors w~N(0,I8), generated directly without library indexing
fresh_prompt_design.label_sampling: y = x dot task + 0.5 epsilon, epsilon iid N(0,1)
fresh_prompt_design.prediction: model output at x-token k after k observed labels; future labels are not observed

baselines_and_metrics.ridge: exact float64 solve with lambda=noise variance on the first k observed labels
baselines_and_metrics.atomic: streamed all-atom dMMSE over the full actual nested training-library prefix as a finite-library comparator; no truncation or nearest-neighbor approximation
baselines_and_metrics.N2: exact finite-n Gaussian second moment in float64 for each context prefix
baselines_and_metrics.C: (L_T-L_C)/(L_D-L_C), flagged unstable when denominator <= max(1e-8,0.01 L_C)
baselines_and_metrics.bootstrap: 2000 paired-prompt resamples within each condition/prefix, deterministic seed derived from the frozen independent seed

independent_checks.task_generator: assert task schema has no task indices, replay the frozen seed exactly, require alternate seed changes tasks, and check Gaussian task moments
independent_checks.shared_prompts: generate the prompt bank once and pass the same arrays/file hash to all four conditions and four prefixes
independent_checks.n2: compare batched float64 formula against independent per-prompt float64 solves on first 8 prompts
independent_checks.atomic: compare streamed result against materialized float64 posterior on first 8 prompts and first min(4096,M) atoms
independent_checks.causal_mask: replace every target from position k onward and require x-token-k prediction max absolute change <= 1e-7
independent_checks.finite_predictions: require all model, baseline, and metric inputs/outputs finite

pilot_rule: Run a 128-prompt/100-bootstrap CPU pilot first. Run the full 4096-prompt/2000-bootstrap local evaluation only if measured runtime extrapolates to a few hours or less; otherwise retain the tested package and measured runtime.
interpretation_limits: Checkpoints are interrupted selected follow-ups, not training-seed robustness.
A prompt bootstrap quantifies prompt variation only, not model-seed uncertainty.
No mechanism, Fisher, Jacobian, Hessian, or training claims are made.
